item.tib: dbal gsas rngam pa drag po gting rdzogs kyi mdel kha'i gtor zlog
item.coloph: gsang ba 'dus pa'i dgongs pa'o/ bla chen dran pa'i thugs dam ni/ gyer gyis bka' yi gter dang dngos grub bla ma rma ston la babs pa'o/ de nas rim bzhin du bru ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ de nas me gnyos rnam gnyis/ de nas 'gro ba'i mgon po 'a zha bdud rtsi rgyal mtshan dang 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan la'o/ de nas sde skor so sor mkhyen pa phyag bzhes gdan sgron kun tu bkrol lo/ rma'i gter nas 'ban zlogs dgra zlog gtor zlog gnad zlog bskang zlog mdos zlog (zlog) kun dwang ra nas so/ gzungs ring yig sna mang nyung gnyis gzungs zlog byad bzlog khol bu'i sde/ sde tshan yig 'phring gsum zangs zangs nas byon no//
